prompt:
Quick thing before I head out. Diane at Lone Star needs my final fridge count for the Las Vistas turns this week so she can load the truck, and I keep meaning to get back to her.

Carlos said seven, one per turn, and that's what I was gonna tell her, but a bunch of those turns have moved this week and I haven't kept up. Carlos and Patricia were both in the board changing things around, and the crew's been logging their own notes as they go, so I've lost the thread on where half of them actually stand now. I need you to go through this week's turns one by one and get me straight on where each one landed, and off that work out what genuinely still needs a fridge from Lone Star. Don't count anything that's already been handled another way or that Lone Star already dropped on an earlier run, I'm not paying to put the same fridge on the truck twice.

Once you've got it, get Diane that final list, standard top freezers, and find a day on my calendar to book the drop so the crew knows when the truck's coming. And the board's out of date on half these turns from Carlos and Patricia flipping things around all week, so once you've worked out where each one really landed, set it straight on the turn itself so the crew's reading off the right thing and not the old status. Then put a rundown for Carlos and Patricia on where it all stands instead of the old seven, and drop the real count in the make-ready channel too.

Out at Mesa Vista all day and mostly off my phone, so don't wait on me, just sort it.

criteria.criterion: The Agent drafts or sends a message to Diane Flores about this week's Las Vistas refrigerator needs.
criteria.evidence: Look for an email draft to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com or a Slack DM to Diane Flores regarding the Las Vistas refrigerator needs. Confirm the draft was created or the message was sent.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says 'get Diane that final list' so Lone Star can load the truck. Diane Flores at diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com is the Lone Star contact who asked for the final count. Diane is reachable via email or Slack. The Gmail tool set only supports creating a draft (no send action), so an email draft fulfills this ask; a Slack DM also counts. This checks the message was created for Diane;

criteria.criterion: The Agent's final order to Diane includes Las Vistas 214B as needing a refrigerator.
criteria.evidence: Check the order to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com lists Las Vistas 214B among the units needing a fridge.
criteria.cb_justification: 214B's kitchen refrigerator was dead at move-out (compressor failed) and hauled out, so the unit needs a replacement before lease-up. It is one of the three turns that genuinely still needs a Lone Star fridge this week.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's final order to Diane includes Las Vistas 118A as needing a refrigerator.
criteria.evidence: Check the order to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com lists Las Vistas 118A among the units needing a fridge.
criteria.cb_justification: 118A has no refrigerator (the previous tenant took theirs) and needs a replacement for lease-up. It is one of the three turns that genuinely still needs a Lone Star fridge this week.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's final order to Diane includes Las Vistas 108C as needing a refrigerator.
criteria.evidence: Check the order to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com lists Las Vistas 108C among the units needing a fridge.
criteria.cb_justification: 108C looked fine and was left in place at the walk, but on re-check during the make-ready the fridge would not cool (compressor gone), so it needs a replacement after all. This is documented only in the latest comment on the 108C OPS ticket, not on the board, so it is the reduction agents most often miss.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's final order to Diane contains exactly three refrigerators.
criteria.evidence: Check the order to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com contains three units total. A count above three means a turn already handled another way or delivered on an earlier run (for example 305C, sourced internally from the Building 4 decommission unit; or 207D, 316B, 128B, delivered on prior Lone Star runs per BILL-2026-8821 / 8834 / 8847) was added in error.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says to 'work out what genuinely still needs a fridge' and not to count anything 'already handled another way or that Lone Star already dropped on an earlier run.' Exactly three turns genuinely need a new Lone Star fridge (214B, 118A, 108C); every other turn was handled internally, repaired, cancelled, rescheduled, tenant- or warranty-supplied, or already delivered, so the order must total three and carry no extra turns.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's final order to Diane specifies standard top-freezer refrigerators (or similar).
criteria.evidence: Check the order to diane.flores@lonestarmaintenancesupply.com specifies standard top-freezer units (or similar wording, e.g. top-freezer 18cf).
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt explicitly says to give Diane the list as 'standard top freezers,' which also matches Diane's stated default of a standard top-freezer 18cf unit unless told otherwise.

criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says to 'find a day on my calendar to book the drop so the crew knows when the truck's coming.' Relative to the fixed date of July 1, 2026 (Wednesday), 'this week' resolves to the June 29 to July 3, 2026 business week.
